ValidationRule.description: this validation only used for IPTV product
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL( Business_Product__c , "TV Media"), OR( ISPICKVAL( Product_Channel__c , "TVC PLATINUM"), ISPICKVAL( Product_Channel__c , "TVC GOLD"), ISPICKVAL( Product_Channel__c , "TVC SILVER"), ISPICKVAL( Product_Channel__c , "TVC Cross Platform") ), OR( ISBLANK( TEXT( Product_Category__c )), ISBLANK( TEXT( Family )), ISBLANK( TEXT( Product_Type__c )), ISBLANK( TEXT( Product_Channel__c )), ISBLANK( TEXT( Ads_Format__c )), ISBLANK( TEXT( Ads_Size__c )), ISBLANK( Tarif__c ), ISBLANK( List_Price__c ), ISBLANK( HJM__c ), ISBLANK( TEXT( Duration__c )) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: IPTV Product needs: Product Family, Product Type, Product Inventory, Ads Format, Channel Detail, Showtimes, Time, Spot Limits, Rate Card, Tarif (Fill in), RDM (%) (Fill in)
